codeReview.summary: Fail. `git diff 1b7b36385a4c217204d4d42314ddbf7253c9afe2..HEAD -- supabase/functions/ai-gateway/context __tests__` is still empty, so the current HEAD has not changed the reviewed context/test code since the original feature commit. The prior blocking issues therefore remain: attendance still requires literal ISO dates and is not tenant-scoped, and weather enrichment still trusts arbitrary farm IDs and falls back to Nashik coordinates when location data is missing. I also found a new non-blocking weather-detection false-positive and confirmed the test suite still does not execute the real modules.

issues.description: `parseExplicitDate()` still only recognizes literal `YYYY-MM-DD` strings, and `queryFarmRecords()` passes that value straight into `queryWorkers()`. Requests such as 'worker attendance today' or local-language equivalents therefore still skip `worker_attendance` and fall back to the generic active-worker summary, so VAL-BE-009 is still unmet. The current tests even codify this behavior by expecting `parseExplicitDate('today')` and `parseExplicitDate('yesterday')` to return `null` (`__tests__/farm-data-module.test.ts:198-201`).

The attendance lookup still filters only by `date` plus an optional `farm_ids` contains check. It never constrains rows by the authenticated tenant's workers or farm ownership, even though this file uses the service-role client, so omitting `farmId` can still expose other tenants' attendance rows for that day. VAL-BE-025 remains unresolved.

`fetchFarmDetails()` still fetches farms by raw `id` only, with no user-ownership check, and `assembleContext()` still calls it for any supplied `farmId` before weather enrichment. Combined with `fetchWeatherData()` defaulting to Nashik coordinates when `latitude`/`longitude` are missing (`farm-data.ts:1341-1342`), advisory requests can still receive unauthorized or irrelevant weather context instead of skipping enrichment. The prior VAL-BE-025 / VAL-BE-031 failure is still present.

`isWeatherDependentQuery()` is still overly broad for Hindi/Marathi because the regex matches generic tokens such as `आज`, `पाणी`, and `सिंचन`. Unrelated local-language queries (including attendance-today requests) can therefore trigger a weather fetch and inject irrelevant weather context into the assembled prompt.

`assembleContext()` still excludes `farmRecordsContext.citations` from the returned `citations` array, so downstream consumers lose farm-record citations even when farm-backed context was loaded successfully.

The context-module tests still reimplement helper logic inline instead of importing and executing `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/context/farm-data.ts` or `context/assembler.ts` (see also `__tests__/context-assembler.test.ts:8` and `:238`). Because the production modules are never exercised, the passing test suite does not cover the unresolved attendance/weather regressions and overstates actual feature coverage.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The backend-worker workflow is still vulnerable to false confidence from copy-pasted helper tests. The skill should explicitly require importing/executing the production Deno modules (or a documented adapter/harness) rather than reimplementing functions inside Jest files.
